# UI/UX Guidelines

## Core Rules
- About section keeps an editorial two-column layout with ambient blurred background, chip labels, and dual CTA buttons.
- Maintain a stone-neutral palette and keep light/dark parity.
- Use `next/image` for profile/hero media for responsive sizing and performance.

## Usage
Use these rules when modifying layout, typography, or section composition.

## Guardrails
- Do not change the visual direction without explicit approval.
- Preserve existing typography scale unless asked to redesign.
